name: WALK LIKE AN EGYPTIAN
notes: All five facts verified (Cleopatra 30 B.C., Carter 1922, Rosetta 1799, Hatshepsut/Punt); clean ladder, strong hooks.

name: ROME IF YOU WANT TO
notes: Accurate throughout (Rubicon 49 B.C., Flavian Amphitheatre, A.D. 79, Augustus 27 B.C., Punic etymology); good climb.

name: MOUNT RUSHMORE MATERIAL
notes: Rushmore four plus Polk; 'MATERIAL' in the name covers the non-Rushmore fifth; TR 1906 Nobel and 'Young Hickory' check out.

name: STARS OF THE STRIPES
notes: Tubman 'Moses', 381-day boycott, 1845 Narrative/North Star, Seneca Falls 1848 all verified; fair ladder.

name: KEEP CALM AND CARAVEL ON
notes: Columbus-to-Dias ladder is textbook; Cabot/Bristol/Henry VII and Dias 1488 accurate.

name: ICE TO MEET YOU
notes: Amundsen Dec 1911, Endurance 1915, Peary properly hedged as 'claimed', Fram 1893 drift all correct; excellent ramp.

name: KNIGHT MOVES
notes: Chivalry/chevalier etymology, Templar c. 1119/Philip IV, Garter c. 1348 motto all check out.

name: FEUDAL ATTRACTION
notes: $800 'serfs' was a definitional giveaway sitting at $200-level, flattening the ladder; replaced with an original Bayeux Tapestry clue (fact-checked, ~230 ft embroidery); re-scored 47.

name: SITES FOR SORE ARMIES
notes: Waterloo through Gaugamela/Arbela all accurate; Marathon race-name hint is deliberate style; genuine stairs.

name: NAVAL GAZING
notes: Pearl Harbor to Actium 31 B.C. all verified (Nelson died at Trafalgar, four carriers at Midway); strong ladder.

name: FIRST THINGS FIRST
notes: Armstrong/Lindbergh/Gagarin/Hillary/Blackwell (1849, Geneva Medical College) all correct; varied and fair.

name: MOTHER OF INVENTION
notes: Howe's 1854 win over Singer web-verified; Bell March 1876, Marconi 1901/1909 Nobel correct; solid climb.
